name: Lower-third — cinematic with anamorphic flare — CRT Terminal
description: Broadcast-grade lower-third using the lower-third family's `cinematic` variant per ADR-0020. The family's shaderPass adds a constant warm rim glow at the lower-left (implying an off-frame key light), gated to the cinematic variant via a flareEnabled uniform. The anamorphic entrance flare was removed by design — at its peak it read as a line straight through the name. Same recipe as lower-third-cinematic, published under the crt-terminal Pack — the ADR-0038 multi-pack integration demo.
